verdictReason: The independent spec v3 re-review confirms the previously missing technical contracts are now defined; three editorial/sequencing issues remain. It is safe to start isolated TDD increments; behavior dependent on owner decisions remains deferred. No new score was assigned.

issues.description: FR-3 points to an incorrect/inconsistent section for the TSV contract; the catalog is architecture item 3, not a numbered subsection 3.2/3.3.
issues.mitigation: Refer to the architecture item directly rather than a nonexistent subsection number.

issues.description: FR-8 describes the lifecycle naming family as already defined while OQ-6 and the story leave it pending.
issues.mitigation: Keep the naming convention as a suggestion pending owner decision.

issues.description: The plan required contract tests to pass before implementation, reversing the required TDD cycle.
issues.mitigation: Run a failing contract test first, then implementation and refactor; owner decisions gate only dependent behavior.

blockingIssues: Owner decisions OQ-4/OQ-5/OQ-6 block only their dependent behavior.
Editorial/planning QA for spec v3 must close before full story acceptance; independent test-first technical increments may begin.
securityNote: No implementation or runtime security behavior is certified. Catalog interpolation, API error mapping, host scripts and collision upgrade handling require TDD/security tests during implementation.
nextAction: Continue test-first implementation and request independent QA follow-up after current spec/editorial consistency checks.
limitations: The 8.1/10 score belongs only to the earlier spec v1 review; this v3 re-review assigns no score.
No FND-8 runtime behavior has been validated; this review only permits starting isolated TDD increments.
Product decisions OQ-4/OQ-5/OQ-6 remain pending and dependent behavior must not be implemented.

reviewHistory.critiquedBy: Quinn (independent AIOX QA Spec Pipeline review)
reviewHistory.verdictReason: The independent reviewer scored the draft 8.1/10 and identified unresolved implementation-critical contracts. The five findings are recorded as blockers or explicit decisions; implementation is not approved.

issues.description: Host tools need a concrete locale source/consistency contract for bootstrap, database authority, atomic panel updates, offline use, failed writes and recovery.
issues.mitigation: Keep lifecycle-tool implementation blocked until a contract is specified and tested across host/runtime failure states.

issues.description: Catalog serialization, encoding, escaping, placeholders and plural forms are unresolved across browser ESM, Node ESM and host scripts; JSON must not be treated as approved.
issues.mitigation: Choose a shared format that does not add pre-Docker host runtime dependencies, then validate parity and safe interpolation.

issues.description: Streamer-authored text preservation was described as approved in some places and recommended in others.
issues.mitigation: Revised all artifacts to call preservation a recommendation and require owner decision before implementation.

issues.description: No safe upgrade behavior was specified for existing queue slugs/aliases colliding with fila/queue/cola.
issues.mitigation: Record detect-and-block-conflicting-root without automatic rename as a proposal pending owner confirmation; require an upgrade test.

issues.description: The suggested lifecycle family subarushogun_twich_bot_* was described as approved, although exact naming was only proposed.
issues.mitigation: Mark family and suffixes as pending owner confirmation.
